summary.text: Flowing light fruits are colorful fruits formed from dense aurora lights and used as food for Attitude Gu.

claims.text: Fang Yuan plans to spend Lang Ya sect contribution points on flowing light fruits and confirms with Lang Ya land spirit that the exchange is allowed if his contributions are enough.

He leaves with a large number of flowing light fruits and arranges them in his cloud city. They are not ordinary fruits. They form from pure bundles of light, and ordinary people who try to touch them pass through their hands, so special methods are needed to collect them. They do not grow on plants or trees. They are a pure materialization of dense aurora lights. Aurora lights have many colors, and so do the fruits: red, brown, yellow, green, black, blue, purple, and more. Flowing light fruits are the food of Attitude Gu, which is why Fang Yuan exchanges for them.

Light path mortal Gu carry the fruits up through the aperture layers into the highest heaven, where Fang Yuan stores them at a chosen site. The batch is far from enough to fill Attitude Gu: as a rank eight Immortal Gu it waits long between feedings, yet each session needs an enormous amount of fruits. He detonates eighty percent so they become aurora lights, and lets the remaining twenty percent float in that light to nourish more fruits from fruits. Flowing light fruits are a rank six immortal material; using their aurora lights for other planting would consume the light and ruin the fruit plan while the lights still lack a source. Treasure yellow heaven sellers of the fruits include Visitor Can Xia, Qing Hui Zi, and Fairy Cai Xia, and he considers paying for their plantation insights.
Days after storage, the fruits remain in the immortal aperture while he works other problems.
In Mini Orange Heaven, profound lights emit from the flowing light fruits as the result of that earlier farming effort.

To feed Attitude Gu he needs a vast number of flowing light fruits. He has already bought many in treasure yellow heaven, planted them in sovereign blessed land, and uses fruits to bring about more fruits. Between the rows he needs huge amounts of dazzling light Gu to intensify the light so brand new flowing light fruits form.

A small field of aurora lights in Mini Orange Heaven holds many floating flowing light fruits. Light path Gu worms from a jade light pit expand the scale of both the aurora lights and the fruits on their earlier foundation.

More intense aurora light forms more fruits for Attitude Gu, so he buys dazzling light Gu to raise that intensity; light shine fungus is a separate light source he hopes wood path methods can modify toward aurora use.

Modified pure white light shine fungi placed in Mini Orange Heaven make the aurora lights expand and energize the flowing light fruits within. Aurora lights need intense lights, and the floating fungi help those areas toward Attitude Gu’s food requirements.
He keeps watching as the fungi make the aurora lights expand rapidly and nurture more fruits.

Flowing light fruits are a rank six immortal material, formed from extremely dense lights in many colors. Qing Hui Zi gathers aurora lights in immemorial white heaven, buries the light balls in cloud soil, and waters the seedlings with lightning water and magnetic sound until flowing light fruits grow. With those plantation methods he becomes one of the three main sellers of flowing light fruits in treasure yellow heaven. Aurora lights are common in the two heavens, and collecting them himself lowers his production cost.
